idea-plugin.name: Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Chat with Claude from inside Rider.
  • Tool window with conversation history
  • Send the current file or selection as context
  • Cursor position and file path are auto-attached
  • Model and API key configured in Settings → Tools → Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.7.0

  • Paste images (Ctrl+V) or drag-and-drop them into the chat input to send screenshots to Claude.
  • Pending images appear as thumbnails above the input box; each has a small X to remove it before sending.

0.6.0

  • Build now emits updatePlugins.xml next to plugin.zip. Add the file:// URL to Rider's plugin repositories once and Rider will auto-update the plugin on startup whenever a new version is built.

0.5.3

  • Closing the last chat now auto-spawns a fresh empty chat, so the tool window can't get stuck in the "Nothing to show" state.

0.5.2

  • "Close this chat" entry in the hamburger menu - always available, even when JetBrains hides the tab strip (which it does whenever only one chat tab is open).

0.5.1

  • Attach toggle buttons now paint with an accent-blue background when armed, so the on/off state is obvious in any theme.

0.5.0

  • Compact toolbar: attach toggles (sticky, with on/off visual state) on the left, "more options" hamburger on the right.
  • Model selector, agent-mode toggle, and Clear conversation now live in the hamburger menu (with a Custom... entry for free-form model strings).
  • Chat font set to Segoe UI Variable (falls back to Segoe UI / sans-serif when unavailable).

0.4.0

  • Middle-click on a chat tab header to close it.

0.3.2

  • Added CLAUDE.md (project working agreement: commit / version / safety rules).

0.3.1

  • Build script auto-refreshes plugin.zip on every gradle buildPlugin.
  • New auto-build.bat / auto-build.ps1: run once, the plugin rebuilds on every file edit.

0.3.0

  • Renamed to "Claude AI Assistant".

0.2.0

  • Agent mode: Claude can read, edit, and create files in the project (per-write confirmation with diff preview).
  • Auto-approve writes for 5min / 30min / 1hr / until the chat is closed.
  • Multiple independent chat tabs via the "+" button.
  • Per-chat model selector with sticky "last used" memory.
  • Reply streaming.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: chat tool window, file/selection attach, configurable model.
